title: Rest Is Not Quitting | A Discipline Short Film
lines: 9:00 p.m. He closes the laptop. On purpose.
Rest isn't weakness. It's part of the plan.
A blade that's never sharpened eventually fails.
The strongest athletes train hard, and recover harder.
There's a difference between resting and quitting.
Resting means you plan to come back.
Sleep. Breathe. Reset. Then return stronger.
